defs.def: your own; not belonging to or connected with anyone else 个人的；私人的

ex.s: Then, in the 1980s, Bob Johnson created the life story model of identity, in which he proposes that, as we go through life, these core features are built in with our memories to create a personal story through which we understand our lives.
ex.t: 之后，在1980年代，鲍勃·约翰逊创立了身份的人生故事模型，他在模型中提出，在我们经历生命时，这些核心特征与我们的记忆一起构建，以创造一个个人故事，我们通过这个故事来理解我们的生活。

ex.s: What can be inferred about personal stories?
ex.t: 关于个人故事，能推断出什么？

ex.s: How personal stories raise doubts.
ex.t: 个人故事如何引发疑虑。

ex.s: Bring a personal water bottle, sunscreen, and lunch.
ex.t: 带上自己的水壶、防晒霜和午餐。

ex.s: Writing is a matter of personal preferences.
ex.t: 写作是个人偏好的事。

ex.s: Slowing down can contribute significantly to personal growth.
ex.t: 当一些人拒绝接种疫苗并想搭便车，免疫就会失效，每个人都面临更大的危险。

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的个人空间有一些控制权来做你想做的改变。

ex.s: How to have one’s own personal space at home.
ex.t: 如何在家里拥有自己的个人空间。

ex.s: To share some personal understanding of artworks.
ex.t: 分享对艺术作品的某种个人理解。

ex.s: Come and work out with our qualified personal trainer, Jodie McGregor, on the grounds of the Middleton Lodge estate.
ex.t: 来和我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈一起，在米德尔顿洛奇庄园的场地上锻炼吧。

ex.s: Hire a personal trainer.
ex.t: 雇一名私人教练。

ex.s: Personal privacy unprotected.
ex.t: 个人隐私未受保护。

ex.s: Best of all, humor raises your energy, and that can have an effect on everything you do at school, at work, or in your personal life.
ex.t: 最好的是，幽默可以提高你的能量，这可以影响你在学校，工作或个人生活中所做的一切。

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证失效或损坏，或者你更改了个人或课程信息，你应到学生事务中心（SAC）申请补办。

ex.s: Your personal circumstances are equally important.
ex.t: 你的个人处境同样重要。

ex.s: Not only will you help our young volunteers to develop personally，you'll also learn new skills and increase your cultural awareness.
ex.t: 你不仅能帮助我们年轻的志愿者个人成长，还会学到新技能并提高你的文化意识。

ex.s: Success means getting personal desires satisfied
ex.t: 成功意味着个人欲望得到满足

ex.s: If a basketball star is. for example，trying to gain a high personal point total，he may take a shot himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate，affecting the team's performance.
ex.t: 例如，如果一个篮球明星试图获得更高的个人得分总数，在把球传给队友可能更好的情况下，他可能会自己投篮，从而影响球队的表现。

ex.s: Fire extinguishers are located on each floor and in each apartment． Use a fire extinguisher only if you have been trained to do so． Irresponsible use of a fire extinguisher can create a dangerous situation for other residents and could result in damage to personal property． Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines．
ex.t: 每层楼和每个公寓都配有灭火器。只有在受过训练时才可使用。不负责任地使用灭火器会给其他住户带来危险，并可能损坏个人财产。滥用灭火器将被罚款。

ex.s: “People could talk about gaining knowledge or personal growth,” says Johnson.
ex.t: Johnson说:“人们可以谈论获得知识或个人成长。”

ex.s: Art is deeply personal, because when two people see the same artwork, our perception can create vastly different experiences of meaning.
ex.t: 艺术是非常个人的，因为当两个人看到同一件艺术品时，我们的感知可以创造出截然不同的意义体验。

ex.s: How can other people’s personal stories probably benefit us?
ex.t: 2023年研究的狗如何回应"不能"的行为？

ex.s: But personal opinions?
ex.t: 但个人的看法（观点）呢？

ex.s: If people always exchange true personal information online, then yes, these friendships can be real and meaningful.
ex.t: 如果人们在网上总是交流真实的个人信息，那么可以，这些友谊可以是真实而有意义的。

ex.s: Share your personal experience about the family dinner.
ex.t: 分享你关于家庭聚餐的亲身经历。

ex.s: Concerned with love, death and betrayal, Hamlet gives no easy answers to the questions it raises, and everyone understands it in a personal way.
ex.t: 《哈姆雷特》关注爱、死亡与背叛，它对自己提出的问题没有给出简单的答案，每个人都以个人的方式理解它。

ex.s: Key actions Personal qualities 2 Organise your talk following the steps below.
ex.t: 关键行动 个人品质 2 按照以下步骤组织你的演讲。

ex.s: Finally, … Name Achievement Personal qualities Reasons for recommendation Useful expression ?
ex.t: 最后,... 姓名成就 个人品质 推荐的理由 有用表达？

defs.def: connected with individual people, especially their feelings, characters and relationships 人际的；个性的

ex.s: I’ve discovered that if I show students how what they learn is relevant to my hobbies, they’re much more willing to make connections to their personal interests and develop their own hobbies.
ex.t: 我发现，如果我向学生展示所学内容与我的爱好的关联，他们就更愿意把知识与自己的兴趣联系起来，并培养出自己的爱好。

defs.def: not connected with a person's job or official position 私人的；私事的
done by a particular person rather than by sb who is acting for them 亲自做的

ex.s: fetch it at the SAC personally
ex.t: 亲自去SAC领取

defs.def: made or done for a particular person rather than for a large group of people or people in general 为某人做的；个别的
referring to a particular person's character, appearance, opinions, etc. in a way that is offensive 针对个人的；人身攻击的

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: How timing affects personal identity.
ex.t: 一扇窗户里的动静引起了我的注意，于是我走了进去。

ex.s: But that didn't stop China Daily from asking me last week to share a personal story for a video project about the integration of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province.
ex.t: 但这并没有阻止《中国日报》上周邀请我为一个关于京津冀一体化的视频项目分享个人故事。

defs.def: connected with a person's body 人身的；身体的
